reviews.comment:
Mala experiencia... llegamos y no había combustible.. a lo que la persona que atendía nos respondió que no sabia hasta cuando de mala manera. Los baños un desastre... un olor insoportable.. los inodoros marrones de la suciedad.. sin papel higiénico. Pésima experiencia.

(Translated by Google)
Bad experience... we arrived and there was no fuel... the person at the station rudely told us they didn't know when it would be available. The bathrooms were a disaster... an unbearable smell... the toilets were brown with filth... and there was no toilet paper. Terrible experience.
